about_the_game:
The game name is tentatively set as "Strange Dream", game reminder/communication group 1032181602,

Shareholders and audience grandfathers! If you have any ideas or creativity, be sure to throw them into the comment section or join the group (1032181602) for discussion! Your suggestions are the core driving force for making the game better! Don't forget to pay attention to the development progress, and the three consecutive hints [doge] are the greatest spiritual support for the development team! The Strange Dream cannot be separated from the strong help of all the grandfathers! See you in our group, let's polish this nuclear dream together!

Current style ideas:

Various types of nuclear art: Chinese Dream Core, Monster Core, Children's Core, Old Core, Simulated Terror, Concrete Core, Toilet Core, Cleaning Core, Flower Core, Back Room (Style Only), Threshold Space, etc

Nostalgic tearful eyes+various nuclear art+a small amount of melancholic/slightly fearful elements (not intended to be terrifying, but hoping to create a nostalgic tearful eyes that everyone likes)

Current plot idea:

You had a dream, but you found that you couldn't wake up, and the contents of the dream were very strange. You could only explore step by step and finally return to that restless city Do you really want to go back?

Current considerations for gameplay: (The following is for reference only, team technology and size determine that only mini versions of these can be made)

1. Puzzle solving: 3D and 2D puzzles, some classic puzzles, find differences, guess dream core elements

2. Physics mini games: Chess landing on the chessboard, catching water, Chinese ball games, table tennis, building bridges

3. Parkour: Various types of parkour (not limited to operator parkour), chase battles, and wall fights

4. Classic games: Moving ring targets, hitting glass beads, realistic street vendor games, and 3D replica classic 4399 games

5. Shooting: beach landing, shooting balloons (balloons that can be moved, different types of balloons, BUFF balloons), tower defense and monster shooting

(These gameplay elements will be integrated with the game style, and the description is for reference only)

legal_notice:
1. Age classification and content disclosure

This game has passed PEGI Level 12 certification (or ESRB T) and includes the following content:
Threshold space scenes, abstract monster core art expression, and nostalgic melancholy atmosphere may trigger emotional resonance
Mild chase battle (without bloody violence)
Partial clean core/toilet core scenes contain blurred abstract visual stimuli
Note: Chinese Mainland version needs to apply for another version number, and the current version does not include the function of internal purchase

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or newer
  • Processor: Intel i5 or AMD Ryzen 5 from around 2016 or later
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 or AMD Radeon RX 580 or newer
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or newer
  • Processor: Intel i5 or AMD Ryzen 7 from 2018 or later
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 or AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT or newer
  • Storage: 6 GB available space

short_description: You had a dream, but you found that you couldn't wake up, and the content of the dream was very strange. Everything reasonable but unreasonable will happen here. You can only explore step by step, and finally choose to return to that restless urban era Do you really want to go back?

Simplified Chinese*, English*
